'One primitive, placed wherever there's a bar' (12) and 'The primitive that runs on cadence' (23) are catalogue-entry labels naming their own subject -- the rule's own explicit NOT-violation category ('Ralph', 'The numbers') -- not imperatives or phase labels, so the mood switch the rule protects (instructing vs. declaring) is never crossed.
